content.text:
2 Things That Could Hit the Brakes on the AI Boom. Why Hyperscalers Could Benefit.
If it wasn’t already clear before last week (it was), the new chokepoint for the artificial-intelligence investment boom has gone from equipment and energy supply to capital and politics.
